Exact integer arithmetic, byte count and independent-family denominator
sources.details: Hand calculation: TOOL(4)+colon(1)+calculator(10)+colon(1)+1+2(3)=19 ASCII/UTF-8 bytes. Compact JSON pieces {"name":(8)+"calculator"(12)+,"arguments":(13)+{"a":1,"b":2}(13)+outer }(1)=47. 1+2=2+1=3; 4+4=8; 0+1=1+0=1. Parameter strings 2+1 and 1+2 remain unequal. Each of5 held-out validation number families has2 calculator orientations,2 unavailable orientations and1 independent return:10,10,5; the last5 are separate prompts, not5 extra complete loops. Six test number families similarly give12,12,6;10/12 successful full test loops means2 failures. These denominators are also recomputed from every actual record in a_audit.
